resources.string: Starting the built-in route… Reopen this screen to check its status.
The built-in route is running. Check Telegram’s connection indicator to confirm that the service is reachable.
Normal connection: direct, your VPN or your configured proxy.
The built-in route could not start. Your normal connection has been restored. You can try again.
Connection settings changed. Reopen this screen.

The built-in route uses Telegram WebSocket endpoints and can help when a direct connection is unavailable. It does not require an external proxy app, but availability depends on your network. It is a connection option, not a VPN or an anonymity service.\n\nThe mode applies to all accounts in this app and stays enabled until you disable it, choose a normal proxy or restart the app. Your saved proxy settings remain intact.
